mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact-form maximization of L(t) on [0,1], exceptional sectors, open affine preimages and common-j intersection; two actual inverse-derived principal controls checked at one shared curvature.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Real conditional derivation; exact SymPy integer/radical identities and Lean algebra; IEEE double actual inverse controls.
mathematics.conventions: K=K0+A*j; T=beta*(K-I); beta>0, R<0, b fixed; strict q(t)>0 in every direction, not a weak/touching cone. j=F_XX is shared, never retuned separately by halo.
inputs: 54 synthetic pencils tested at six controls each
Two actual inverse-derived backgrounds eps=(1e-6,2e-6), y=.1, X=.5, F=.525, f=.05, bscale=.25, dscale=1.5; no common P/G matching asserted
non_claims: Actual control pair has different P/PX/GX and is not a common-action construction.
No physical-frame, cosmological, matter-filled, global-boundary, full Hamiltonian or Dirac certificate.
Floating endpoints are conditional on input precision; no interval-arithmetic enclosure.
No dark-matter particles or per-halo acceleration scale; explicit clock retained.
beta<=0, R>=0 and nonfinite/unorderable inputs are excluded from this reduction, not universal physical no-gos.
